item.title: Incarico post-doc: Clinical decision support systems in dialysis: ethical and epistemological perspectives Interreg It-Ch - ON THE DOT - CUP D19I24001680007; Target-D - CUP D19I21000180 - 2026_IPD_DCMC_3 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:

Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-02 Logica, storia e filosofia delle scienze e delle tecniche

We are seeking a candidate with a background in the philosophy of science, the philosophy of medicine, and the ethics of technology, with a focus on the ethical and epistemological implications of digital technologies and algorithmic systems in healthcare. The candidate will analyse the development, interpretation and use of scientific and clinical knowledge in clinical decision-support systems for dialysis care. The ethical implications in terms of accountability, transparency and patient information in the context of chronic conditions, frailty and end-of-life care will be assessed for systems developed in the Target-D and OnTheDOT projects. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Gender-affirmation processes and psychological well-being in transgender and non-binary people: lived experiences, minority stress, and affirmative clinical practice (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

The research focuses on psychological well-being and on identity-construction and gender-affirmation processes in transgender and non-binary people, within a clinical and dynamic framework. Activities include literature review, data collection and analysis using qualitative and mixed-methods approaches (semi-structured interviews, focus groups), and the study of the subjective experience of gender dysphoria and of minority stress, together with their implications for affirmative clinical practice. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

The research project aims to investigate the development of social understanding skills, with particular reference to Theory of Mind, and future-oriented thinking in preschool children aged 3 to 5 years. To this end, the project will examine the role of various social and cognitive correlates potentially involved in the development of these competencies. Specifically, the relationships between these abilities and children’s executive functions will be investigated, and particular attention will be paid to the role of parental behaviors and practices in promoting their development. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Eating disorders: clinical diagnosis and research on treatment effectiveness (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

The project aims to investigate feeding and eating disorders (FED) by integrating clinical and diagnostic assessment with empirical research on the effectiveness of psychological and integrated treatments. The activities will include: clinical and psychodiagnostic evaluation using validated tools for personality, mental functioning, and symptomatology; collection and management of clinical and outcome data; statistical analyses of factors associated with treatment response; and contribution to the writing of scientific papers and dissemination of results within SSD PSIC-04/A, GSD 11/PSIC-04 – Clinical and Dynamic Psychology

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/HIST-02 Storia moderna

The research activity will focus on the role of women in the formation of the public sphere and in political relations between civil and religious powers in modern Europe, with particular attention to their connections with the Atlantic Revolutions. The research will examine forms of women’s participation in political life and in the circulation of ideas, information, and practices of political interaction, with particular reference to transnational networks and forms of informal diplomacy that developed between Europe and the Mediterranean. Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-05 Storia della filosofia

The research programme is connected to the ERC NEWWORLD’s work package on “visual ecology”, with special regard to the curation of a philosophical exhibition. From conceptual perspective, it involves collaborating with the other members of the ERC team to select the exhibits (including digital elements) and to develop the overall concept of the exhibition. Particular attention will be devoted to the representation of space, drawing on maps and cosmographies. This work will lead to a series of publications on the relationship between text and images, with particular attention to the Renaissance, including for a volume to be edited by the ERC team on the longue durée of ecology.
